scope: Exact last-pane decision brief and owner reply from this owner-authorized session only. The assistant recommendation is advisory; the owner selects detach/session-keeps-running and explicitly separates optional UX/cleanup. No fifteen-minute default or extra UI requirement is selected.

records.text:
One product decision changes the lifecycle design: **what closing the last terminal pane means.**

```text
Today:
close pane → retain for Undo → last owner expires → retire session

Option A:
close pane → detach view → session keeps running
explicit “end session” → retire session

Option B:
close pane → retain for Undo → retire session
network disconnect → session keeps running
```

I recommend **A** for independently managed sessions. It makes closing a view distinct from ending work; users would need a clear session list and explicit termination, and operators would retain the background resource cost. **B** preserves today’s cleanup behavior and limits abandoned sessions, but closing the pane can still end remote work.

If deferred, session-retirement contracts remain open. The API, transport and capability survey can continue.
